names: Runs saved vs expected, strict pressure
Win probability added defending the last 2 overs and close games
Pressure creation: win probability added above expected in overs 1-6, non-pressure balls
Pressure delta: runs saved under pressure minus own non-pressure runs saved
Share of pressure spells with positive win impact
Downside: size of the bad pressure spells
Bounce-back: runs saved + wicket value on the ball after conceding a boundary (game live)
Tail clean-up: win impact against batting-order 8-11 while the game is live
